Configuration.description: An optional configuration specification to be used when provisioning application configurations.

Configurations.description: A list of additional configurations to apply within a configuration object.

Properties.description: A set of properties specified within a configuration classification.

LogTypesMap.description: A map of log component names to the list of log types to publish for that component.

SessionCloudWatchLoggingConfiguration.description: The CloudWatch Logs configuration for the session.

Enabled.description: Whether CloudWatch Logs is enabled for the session.

EncryptionKeyArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key used to encrypt the logs published to CloudWatch Logs.

LogGroup.description: The name of the log group where session logs are published.

LogStreamNamePrefix.description: The prefix applied to the log stream name where session logs are published.

SessionManagedLoggingConfiguration.description: The Amazon EMR-managed logging configuration for the session.

Enabled.description: Whether Amazon EMR-managed logging is enabled for the session.

EncryptionKeyArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key used to encrypt the managed logs.

SessionMonitoringConfiguration.description: The monitoring configuration for a session. Controls where session logs are published.

SessionS3LoggingConfiguration.description: The Amazon S3 logging configuration for the session.

Enabled.description: Whether Amazon S3 logging is enabled for the session.

EncryptionKeyArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key used to encrypt logs published to Amazon S3.

LogUri.description: The Amazon S3 destination URI where session logs are published.

Tag.description: A key-value pair containing user-defined metadata that you can associate with an Amazon EMR resource.

Key.description: A user-defined key, which is the minimum required information for a valid tag.

Value.description: A user-defined value, which is optional in a tag.

schema.description: An Amazon EMR Spark Connect session. A session is an interactive workload started on an Amazon EMR cluster that has Spark Connect sessions enabled, and is supported in Amazon EMR Spark 8.0.0 and later.

AccountId.description: The Amazon Web Services account ID that owns the session.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the session.

ClusterId.description: The ID of the cluster that the session belongs to.

CreatedAt.description: The date and time that the session was created.

EndedAt.description: The date and time that the session was terminated or failed.

EngineConfigurations.description: The configuration overrides for the session. Only runtime configuration overrides are supported.

ExecutionRoleArn.description: The execution role ARN for the session. Amazon EMR uses this role to access Amazon Web Services resources on your behalf during session execution.

IdleSince.description: The date and time that the session last entered the IDLE state.

Name.description: An optional name for the session.

ReleaseLabel.description: The Amazon EMR release label of the cluster that the session is running on.

ServerUrl.description: The Spark Connect server URL for the session.

SessionIdleTimeoutInMinutes.description: The idle timeout, in minutes. If the session is idle for this duration, Amazon EMR automatically terminates it.

StartedAt.description: The date and time that the session entered the STARTED state.

State.description: The current state of the session.

StateChangeReason.description: A human-readable message describing the most recent state change.

Tags.description: The tags associated with the session.

UpdatedAt.description: The date and time that the session was last updated.
